originalReview.notes: The finished accessible path establishes a narrow light-gray concrete route, with angular pale boulders crowded along its sides. Its exact connection to the short mapped visitor-center approach is approximate.

originalReview.notes: The visible log walls and divided glazing give detail for the historic public visitor center. Exhibits and people are outside the reference scope.
NPS east exterior view. The string of horizontal brown logs, light joints, dark low shingle roof, simple central door, divided glazing and two small masonry chimney caps are visible.

quallaSearch.notes: Started with two National Park Service originals already published in Qualla for the log construction and walkway. A credited public-domain NPS exterior completes the architectural view. The USGS survey and published federal geology establish the shape of the monolith. The historical Qualla photograph was excluded from the reference inventory because its creator credit needed reconciliation.
